# One case of place_job, on Maya's rooftop-garden app.
case	Maya's machines are off, Tenki is not connected and GitHub's minutes are used up, so the job waits for her machines
places	order=own,tenki,github wait=10
job	linux	pr	self-hosted,linux,pr
keep	on
queued	0
gone	yes
now	1793000000
runner	offline	false	self-hosted,linux,pr
runner	offline	false	self-hosted,linux
expect	own	self-hosted,linux,pr	yes	offline	own:offline,tenki:not-connected,github:gone
words	No place could take this build. It waits for your machines until one is free.
